published_selection_scope: Four separately frozen run identities; a shared warm-seed winner remains explicitly labeled, and failed quality positions retain null without replacement. No joint information-gate claim or pooling with proposed W winners.
published_audit_contract: Separate zero-error authoring and TRAIN audit receipts bind the exact final selection SHA, phase and TEST_accessed=false. Retain every original audit byte; root release binds both audit SHAs.
runtime_scope: Unchanged original R2 kernel/config/native methods/weights/failure semantics/cost charging. Common CHILS-half initialization executes once per context/target, while each warm policy is charged its measured standalone initial-plus-repair cost.
before_TEST: No candidate binding, source freeze, input preparation or TEST execution until independent R2 four-W audit and published author/TRAIN audits pass and root authorizes the corresponding phase. No performance outcome selects any identity or denominator.
